rv.q: Suh had a really great and well-timed idea for this play, but you grasp its point of view early on and there needs to be a few more surprises beyond.
By the final scene, this beautifully moving story about friendship and discovering our place in the world becomes an exceptionally entertaining and enlightening evening of theatre.
The Heart Sellers is an intimate and personal story with a universal message.
Standout performances and a moving script alone make The Heart Sellers an enjoyable evening at the theater.
Alcazar and Park's engaging charisma and chemistry on stage provide a delightful, emotional night of joy and laughter, combined with an enthralling sense of sorrow that's unforgettable.

Directed with compassion and candor by Helen Young, Northlight’s revival features the ideally cast duo of Alcazar and Park as the endlessly likable Luna and Jane, strangers turned friends who find in each other the strength and support they need to thrive in their adopted homeland.
The beauty of this play is the way the transitions are made and how realistic the two ladies are in conveying the emotions and feelings that a transplanted person might have.
